messages:
Sara (ml): bringing up raven-lite int8 on canary pool // small canary (500 reqs). seeing funcall structured-output parse failures jump to ~1.7% vs ~0.02% on baseline fp16. short sample in logs shows truncated suffix and a stray comma.

Ben (infra): ugh. is this immediate after quant step or a config change? which commit/candidate image?

Sara (ml): candidate model = raven-lite-int8:v2026-03-17-qa1 (quant pipeline rev 0x9f3). no infra changes. payload shows generator ends with:
```json
{"action":"open_file","path":"/tmp/x","args":{"line":42,},
```
notice trailing comma and closing newline missing. parser throws ``JSONDecodeError: Extra data`` in our toolcall decoder.

Kai: that trailing comma smells like tokenizer emits an extra "," token after quantization shifts logits. did you repro with streaming vs full response?

Sara (ml): repro on both streaming and full. mirrored baseline (fp16) with same prompts -> clean JSON pairs. also tried explicit stop tokens.

Maria (qa): tagging parse-bot to run a quick diff over 10k canary responses for suffix anomalies. parse-bot: run?

parse-bot: started run. sampling 10k responses across two canaries (candidate vs baseline). will post summary in ~20m.

Ben (infra): can we enable JSON-repair rescue for canary only? e.g., soft-heal trims trailing commas and attempts json5 parse then strict. low-risk rollback if we see silent fixes.

Sara (ml): proposal: enable rescue for candidate A only + capture repaired vs unrepaired counts + add a tag to metrics. also capture token-level topk diffs around end-of-response.

Kai: also capture tokenizer->byte mapping for final tokens. I suspect a rare off-by-one where int8 rounding nudges EOS placement so model emits a partial token sequence that looks like ",}".

Maria (qa): parse-bot results: candidate failure rate 1.72% (172/10000). of those, rescue heuristics can repair 61% (105/172) into valid JSON. baseline failure rate 0.03% (3/10000). median token-length at failure = 18 tokens.

Sara (ml): thanks. can we get a small labeled set of failures (20) for manual inspection? plz include raw token ids + decoded bytes.

parse-bot: attached 20 failure samples to /tmp/raven-lite-parsetriage-1737777001.log (s3 link: https://s3.redwood/tests/raven-lite/1737777001-samples.log).

Ben (infra): plan options: 1) keep candidate but enable repair by default for canary + flag for telemetry, 2) fallback routing to baseline for toolcall endpoints only, 3) roll back model.

Kai: quick experiment idea: rerun quantization with alternative group-size and symmetric calibration on the handful of failure examples. if failures drop significantly we can patch pipeline.

Sara (ml): will run targeted quant re-run with group-size 64 vs 128 and post results tomorrow morning. Maria, can you do a quick human review on the 20 samples and mark which are "acceptable repaired" vs "must-fail"?

Maria (qa): can do. ETA EOD PST.

Ben (infra): meanwhile I put a temporary route rule to mirror toolcall traffic: candidate gets mirrored to baseline and we use baseline parse result if candidate fails parse. configured TTL 6h and metrics tag "mirror-parse-fallback=true".

Sara (ml): nice. that keeps customers safe while we iterate. adding checklist: (a) run quant re-runs and report delta (b) parser-repair + telemetry on canary (c) human triage of 20 samples (d) decide on rollout or rollback after 24h.

Kai: FYI added a small binary diff script to compare final token logits around end-of-response. put in PR https://git.redwood/eng/llm-tools/pull/421. Sara, run that on the samples.

Sara (ml): will run tonight. tagging @maria to confirm once triage done. thanks all :thumbsup:

Maria (qa): triage done: of 20 samples 12 = acceptable after repair (meaning user intent preserved), 8 = corrupted meaning repair produced ambiguous structure. forwarding details in s3 manifest.

Sara (ml): given that, leaning to disable full rollout until quant pipeline tweak. Kai — if your rerun reduces corrupted count to <=2/20 we can greenlight gradual ramp with repair enabled.

Kai: starting reruns now. I'll post numeric comparison and a quick canary PR with new quant artifact if results look good.

Ben (infra): monitoring dashboard updated: watch metric "toolcall.parse.failure_rate" on canary vs baseline, and alert if mirror fallback > 0.5%.

Sara (ml): perfect. will update this thread with numbers. last_message_ts: 1737777181"
